record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Quantum Information Theory
record.context_brief: Bell violation activated by tensor products
record.original_question: Can there exist bipartite density operators rho1 and rho2 such that neither rho1 nor rho2 violates any CHSH Bell inequality individually, but their tensor product rho1 tensor rho2 does violate a CHSH Bell inequality?

evidence.quote: Can one find bipartite density operators ρ1,2, neither of which violates any CHSH Bell inequality, with the property that ρ1 ⊗ ρ2 does?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\rho$ be a density operator on a bipartite Hilbert space $\mathcal{H}_A \otimes \mathcal{H}_B$. Say that $\rho$ violates the CHSH Bell inequality if there exist Hermitian operators $A_0, A_1$ on $\mathcal{H}_A$ and $B_0, B_1$ on $\mathcal{H}_B$ with eigenvalues in $[-1,1]$ such that
$$|\mathrm{Tr}(\rho(A_0\otimes B_0 + A_0\otimes B_1 + A_1\otimes B_0 - A_1\otimes B_1))| > 2.$$
Otherwise, $\rho$ is said to admit no CHSH violation.

Question: Do there exist bipartite density operators $\rho_1$ on $\mathcal{H}_{A_1}\otimes \mathcal{H}_{B_1}$ and $\rho_2$ on $\mathcal{H}_{A_2}\otimes \mathcal{H}_{B_2}$ such that neither $\rho_1$ nor $\rho_2$ violates any CHSH Bell inequality, but the tensor product $\rho_1\otimes \rho_2$, viewed as a bipartite state across the cut $(A_1A_2)\,|\,(B_1B_2)$, does violate a CHSH Bell inequality?
artifact.status_search_result: Navascués and Vértesi (arXiv:1010.5191, "Activation of Non-Local Quantum Resources", 2011) exhibited two-qubit states such that neither state (nor any number of copies of either state alone) violates the CHSH inequality, while their tensor product produces a CHSH value of at least 2.023. This affirmatively answers the question.

status_evidence.title: Activation of Non-Local Quantum Resources
status_evidence.snippet: Two two-qubit states are found such that any number of copies of one state or the other cannot violate the CHSH Bell inequality, but their tensor product can produce a CHSH violation of at least 2.023.
status_evidence.claim: Existence of CHSH-local states whose tensor product violates CHSH is established.
